Born with a limb difference and later the first visibly disabled baker on The Great British Bake Off, Briony May Williams traces her journey from shame to pride. She makes the case that visibility and acceptance aren't favours, they're how we change millions of lives, including, one day, our own.

TEDxBristol 2025 was held at We The Curious (https://wethecurious.org/), Bristol's much-loved science centre on the city's historic harbourside, and beautifully filmed and edited by the team at Watch & Learn Productions (watchandlearnproductions.com).

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx Briony May Williams is a television presenter and baker, best known as the first visibly disabled contestant on The Great British Bake Off. 

Born with a limb difference, she has become a prominent advocate for disability visibility and acceptance, presenting for Channel 4 and Food Unwrapp

author: TEDx Talks
description:
THE PITCH
The brands that win don’t put themselves at the centre of the story — they make their customers the hero and step into the role of the guide.
THE CORE IDEA
For decades, brands have been told to build a strong identity, a clear voice, a compelling story  and then broadcast it to the world. This talk dismantles that model entirely. Drawing from Joseph Campbell’s Hero’s Journey and Donald Miller’s StoryBrand framework, the talk argues that every great brand story has the customer as the protagonist and the brand as the mentor, the Yoda, the Gandalf. The moment a brand tries to be the hero, it loses the audience. The moment it empowers the customer to become the hero, it earns loyalty that no advertising budget can buy.
“People don’t want to follow your brand. They want your brand to follow them into who they’re becoming.”
WHY THIS MATTERS NOW
Social media has shifted power from brands to individuals; the customer now controls the narrative

title: You Are Not the Hero of Your Brand Story | Dafe Richards | TEDxMcPherson U

author: TEDx Talks
description:
As university students and young people trying to figure life out, we often feel the pressure to have it all together, from getting the perfect course, the right hustle, to even the ideal plan. We scroll through social media and see people our age “winning,” and it makes us question if we’re doing enough. But what if real success isn’t about following trends or chasing money, but about discovering you?

So the aim of this topic is to reminds us that our greatest asset isn’t in a bank account but in who we are. Our ideas, creativity, and individuality are powerful currencies that can open doors and create real financial opportunities when used right. “The Currency of You” challenges us as young individuals to stop comparing our pace with others and to start investing ourselves, our skills, passions, and personal growth. Because when you embrace your uniqueness, you don’t just build wealth, you build confidence, purpose, and lasting value. The message isn’t about chasing money, but not
title: The Currency of You: How Authenticity Builds Real Wealth:  | Oluchukwu Chiadika | TEDxMcPherson U

description:
What happens when life changes your plans before you are ready for it?

In this deeply personal and inspiring talk, Ankita Mehra takes us through a journey shaped by childhood trauma, family struggles, bullying, self-doubt, unexpected choices, and moments when life seemed to say “no.” From witnessing her father’s life-changing crisis as a child to giving up a dream college, navigating a challenging first job, choosing learning over money, leading teams, building a professional identity, and eventually finding herself beyond that identity, Ankita shares how resilience became more than a quality it became a way of life.

Her story is a reminder that success is not always about choosing the most obvious path. Sometimes, it is about making the best of the path life gives you.

title: I Don’t Say No Until I’ve Tried a Hundred Ways to Turn It Into a Yes | Ankita Mehra | TEDxKKWIEER

description:
Può uno spazio influenzare come ci sentiamo ancora prima di accorgercene?
Nel suo talk ci accompagna a scoprire come l’architettura non sia solo ciò che vediamo, ma ciò che il corpo percepisce e trasforma in emozione.
Attraverso la neuroarchitettura, Andrea racconta come luce, forme e percezioni possano guidare il nostro benessere e cambiare il modo in cui viviamo i luoghi ogni giorno. Designer e fondatore dello Studio Andreani Spazi di Valore, da oltre 25 anni si occupa di progettazione degli spazi con un approccio centrato sulla persona e sul benessere. Nel suo percorso unisce design e neuroarchitettura, studiando l’impatto che luce, colori, forme e materiali hanno sulle emozioni e sulla qualità della vita.

title: Neuroarchitettura, l'ambiente che diventi. | Andrea Impiombato Andreani | TEDxConegliano

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Cosa hanno in comune un astronauta e un educatore?
Nel suo talk a #TEDxConegliano2026, Michela esplora il potere invisibile delle relazioni educative: come ogni incontro, ogni parola ricevuta, ogni gesto di cura contribuisce a rimuovere ostacoli, costruire ponti e accendere possibilità. Perché l’educazione non è solo istruzione. È la spinta che ci porta oltre i nostri limiti, verso ciò che ancora non sappiamo di poter essere. Filosofa di formazione e psicologa educativa e clinica, ama definirsi prima di tutto un’educatrice. Si occupa inoltre di tutela dei minori e prevenzione del disagio, con un forte impegno nella costruzione di reti di supporto sul territorio.
È docente universitaria allo IUSVE, presidente dell’ISRE e tutore legale volontario per giovani in situazioni di fragilità, oltre a svolgere attività di formazione per enti e professionisti. Nel 2017 è stata insignita del titolo di Cavaliere al Merito della Repubblica Italiana.
A TEDx condividerà un talk sul valore dell’educaz
title: INGEGNI educativi per la vita. | Michela Possamai | TEDxConegliano

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Cosa succede quando l’arte smette di essere solo un oggetto da guardare e diventa un’esperienza in cui entrare?Nel suo lavoro esplora i confini tra arti visive, realtà virtuale e media immersivi, dove la fruizione culturale cambia forma e significato. Racconta anche il valore delle opere mai realizzate, dimostrando che l’arte può esistere anche oltre lo spazio fisico. 
Nel suo talk ci invita a superare la cornice per entrare dentro le storie, dove cambiano i luoghi e cambia il modo stesso di guardare. Ricercatrice in Storia dell’arte contemporanea all’Università IULM di Milano e autrice di saggi. Nel suo percorso si occupa di arti visive, cultura videoludica e media immersivi, concentrandosi sui nuovi modi di fruire l’arte. E’ co-fondatrice di MoRe, un archivio digitale visionario dedicato ai progetti d’arte contemporanea rifiutati o mai realizzati.
A TEDx condividerà un talk su come cambiano i modi di vivere e immaginare l’arte, offrendo uno sguardo su nuove forme di esperienza immer
title: Display. Un concetto palindromo | Elisabetta Modena | TEDxConegliano

description:
Gupse Berrin Çakar, başarıyı başkalarının çizdiği yollarda değil, insanın sevdiği şeyi keşfedip onu cesaretle üretmesinde arayan kendi hikâyesini anlatıyor. Mengen Gastronomi mezunu olan Gupse Berrin, üç Michelin yıldızlı Martin Berasategui’de staj yaptıktan sonra şeflik, menü danışmanlığı ve eğitmenlik gibi pek çok alanda deneyim kazandı. Ancak içindeki “köyüne dönme” arzusu galip geldi ve 2021’de Susurluk’un Demirkapı köyünde, 150 yıllık aile evini restore ederek hayalini kurduğu restoranı gupse’deni kurdu.
Menülerini mevsime, toprağa ve yerel ürünlere göre şekillendiren Gupse Berrin, butik şeflik anlayışıyla misafirlerini kendi evinde ağırlar gibi karşılıyor. Köy kadınlarıyla birlikte üretim yaparak hem geleneksel lezzetleri yaşatıyor hem de yerel istihdama katkı sağlıyor. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Asmita Dorjee shares her extraordinary journey of attempting to climb Mount Everest without supplemental oxygen and the difficult decision to turn back. Her story explores a deeper idea of courage: sometimes, the greatest victory is not reaching the summit, but having the strength to know when to come back. Asmita Dorjee comes from a family with a strong mountaineering background, where resilience, determination, and teamwork have been part of her journey from an early age. Passionate about learning, personal growth, and helping others unlock their potential, she has always embraced challenges with courage and perseverance.

In 2022, Asmita attempted to summit Mount Everest with O2 and came remarkably close, turning back just 100 metres short of the summit. Rather than letting the setback define her, she returned in 2023 and successfully completed the climb, this time with supplemental oxygen.

title: The Courage to come back | Asmita Dorjee | TEDxBistupur
